system.description:
The mage reshapes inanimate matter, changing an object’s form, density, or composition, such as softening a steel bar or turning a key blank into a working key. Rank 2 alters properties; rank 3 transmutes one material into another. Successes govern how drastic and lasting the change is.

Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Matter 3; mechanics paraphrased.
